title: AddressUnreachableError

address.description: The address the preview was asked of, as its origin.

details.description: What the key manager or the environment said behind the plain message, one line each, for Details: addresses, paths, HTTP statuses and system error codes. Absent when there is nothing more.

description: The address could not be reached, or completed no TLS handshake within ten seconds: no certificate was read. The message says what failed in plain words; data names the address, and its details the raw words.
